content_blocks.title: Reference example: Client-Side Caching
content_blocks.code:
import os
import redis

r = redis.Redis.from_url(os.environ["REDIS_URL"], decode_responses=True)
print(r.ping())
content_blocks.run_instructions: Install redis-py in a local virtual environment, set REDIS_URL for a disposable development instance, and never commit credentials.
content_blocks.reset_steps: The snippet performs a read-only ping; close the client or connection pool when the application shuts down.
content_blocks.note: Use a disposable development keyspace. Treat this as a learning example, not a production-ready policy without boundary tests.
